svg.title: LLM, effort, permission mode, and usage are separate controls
svg.desc: The app's message composer sits above Model, High effort, Auto permission mode and a usage circle. Matching numbers connect them to four distinct illustrations: a selector with LLM A chosen over LLM B, a graduated effort dial, a file-edit approval dialog, and a weekly allowance ring with a calendar and clock for the next reset. The approval dialog is labeled as appearing when approval is needed, not before every Auto-mode action. LLM choice, reasoning effort, approval behavior and usage are separate concepts.
